task: Implement review_run_start workspace diagnostics and Authority boundary regression coverage.
outcome: When a user runs lattice review_run_start on a direct REVIEW story, the terminal either shows Review run B-xxxx:RR-001 started for koala-review-... with a real head hash, or shows a precise fail-closed message such as no reviewer run was created because git HEAD/materialHash cannot be captured from this workspace, with a concrete cd/init commit next action.
facts: Direct REVIEW story creation now initializes currentReviewRound.
Legacy REVIEW stories missing currentReviewRound are currently repaired by reviewer command entrypoints.
review_run_start signs local REVIEW evidence with HEAD and materialHash.
Local reviewer runs are not Authority Server gate_decision receipts.
Current implementation captures snapshot from ctx.root after assertCwdInWorktree validates process.cwd().
context.ts has worktree path calculation but assertCwdInWorktree does not return the signed root, so a narrow resolver is needed.
constraints: Do not allow review_run_start without real git HEAD and materialHash.
Do not write currentReviewRound repair or review-runs metadata before snapshot readiness succeeds.
Do not normalize only snapshot root while story metadata uses another root.
Do not let Claude/Codex host output set productionDone receiptVerified or authorityChanged.
Only fix correctness issues; avoid broad refactors.
